data.name: Neeti
data.gender_notes: Neeti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Neeti refers to the principles of morality and conduct as mentioned in the ancient Indian text, The Mahabharata. The term is derived from the Sanskrit word 'neetayati', which means 'to guide'. Neeti represents the wisdom and knowledge that guides one through life. The name Neeti carries the meaning “Guidance, Direction” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neeti usually hope their child will grow to embody guidance, direction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Wisdom and guidance from the divine
data.etymology: Neeti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guidance, Direction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neeti total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
